# DN Electric LTD

> Licensed and insured master electricians serving Longmont, Boulder, and the Colorado Front Range. Founded by Master Electrician Matthew Gracia.

- Primary service area (cities listed on electricdn.com): Longmont, Boulder, Loveland, Arvada, Frederick, Denver
- Extended Front Range coverage available — confirm by phone
- Licensed and insured for residential and commercial electrical work in Colorado

## Services
- /services/panel-upgrades — Residential 100A/150A/200A/400A service upgrades, code-compliant, AHJ-permitted
- /services/ev-charger-installations — Level 2 home and business EV chargers, Tesla / Ford / Rivian / NACS / J1772
- /services/lighting-design-and-installation — Indoor / outdoor light fixtures, LED retrofits, ceiling fans
- /services/smart-home-and-ev-ready — Smart switches, structured wiring, EV-ready rough-in for new builds and remodels
- /services/battery-backup-and-generators — Whole-home and partial battery backup, standby generators, ATS
- /services/commercial-electrical — Tenant finish, commercial lighting retrofits, small commercial service work
